title: Parade playing with Petit, Metcalf and Kelly
summary: Hall played parades on a C clarinet with various bands, taking any advertising gig.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: You ever play parades much in the old days? Oh yeah, yeah, sure.
And you used a B clarinet on A clarinet? No, no, I used to use a C. I had a C. C and parades. Yeah, that's right. Who did you work with on the street? Some of the different bands?
Buddy, Gus. Buddy P.T.? Buddy P.T., Gus Madcat, Chris Kelly, whoever would get a parade or get an advertisement, get that gig, we'd play. Sure.
